title: Half Adder and Full Adder
quickIdea: A half adder adds two bits and reports sum and carry; a full adder adds three bits, the third being the carry arriving from the previous position. Sum is XOR, carry is majority.
remember: Half adder: S = A XOR B, C = A AND B. Two inputs, two outputs, four truth-table rows.
Full adder: S = A XOR B XOR Cin, Cout = AB + BCin + ACin. Three inputs, two outputs, eight rows.
The carry is the majority of the three inputs; the sum is 1 exactly when an odd number of the three inputs is 1.

Full adder from two half adders and one OR gate: the first half adder gives A XOR B and AB, the second adds Cin to that XOR, and the two carries AB and (A XOR B)Cin are ORed. This is the lecturer's construction in NPTEL Lecture 23.
Adding two n-bit numbers needs one half adder at the least significant position and n-1 full adders, because only the LSB has no carry-in.
The alternative carry form Cout = AB + (A XOR B)Cin matters for timing: A XOR B is ready before Cin arrives, so the carry costs only one AND and one OR after Cin.

example.prompt: How many full adders and how many half adders are needed to add two 16-bit numbers?
example.work: Position 0 adds two bits and no carry, so a half adder is enough there. Positions 1 to 15 each add two operand bits plus the carry from the position to their right, which is three bits - a full adder. That is 15 full adders.
example.answer: One half adder and fifteen full adders. This is GATE CSE 1999 Q.2.16, accepted answer option (B).

gateAngle: Every adder question in the papers starts from these two blocks: the count of them for an n-bit word (1999 Q.2.16), and their delay when one is built from the other (2015 Set 2 Q.48). The counting is a one-line argument; the delay needs the carry path written out.

variations.label: ORIGINAL PYQ-STYLE QUESTION
variations.question: How many full adders and half adders are needed to add two 8-bit numbers, and what changes if the least significant position is also a full adder with its carry-in tied to 0?
variations.answer: One half adder and seven full adders. With a full adder at position 0 and Cin = 0 the circuit is still correct - it degenerates to S = A XOR B and Cout = AB - but it wastes the gates that add the tied-off carry.
variations.why: The 1 + (n-1) split is about the carry-in, not about a special block. A full adder whose third input is a constant is a half adder with extra hardware.

variations.label: CONCEPTUAL PRACTICE QUESTION
variations.question: A full adder receives A = 1, B = 1, Cin = 1. What are S and Cout, and which of the three carry terms of Cout is responsible for the carry out?
variations.answer: S = 1 and Cout = 1. All three terms AB, BCin and ACin are 1, so the carry is over-determined rather than caused by one term.
variations.why: Sum is 1 for an odd count of ones (three ones is odd) and the carry is the majority (three of three). The question is a check that sum and carry are independent functions, not complements.

variations.label: PREDICTED VARIATION
variations.question: Two 4-bit numbers 1011 and 0110 are added by a 4-bit ripple-carry adder. What are the four sum bits and the carry out?
variations.answer: Sum bits S3 S2 S1 S0 = 0001 and carry out = 1, i.e. the five-bit result 1 0001 = 17.
variations.why: 11 + 6 = 17 = 10001 in binary. Bit by bit: position 0 gives 1 + 0 = 1, position 1 gives 1 + 1 = 0 carry 1, position 2 gives 0 + 1 + 1 = 0 carry 1, position 3 gives 1 + 0 + 1 = 0 carry 1.

trap.what: Using n full adders for two n-bit numbers and calling the least significant one a full adder without saying why.
trap.why: A full adder at position 0 has an unused carry-in. It works, but it is not the minimum, and the paper asks for the minimum. The 1 + (n-1) count follows from the carry-in existing only from position 1 upward.
trap.counterexample: For 16-bit operands, 16 full adders is a correct circuit but not the answer to 1999 Q.2.16: the accepted answer is 1 half adder and 15 full adders, option (B).

check.question: Using the two-half-adder construction, how many gates does a full adder need if a half adder is one XOR and one AND?
check.answer: Two XOR gates, two AND gates and one OR gate - five gates.
check.explanation: Half adder 1 gives A XOR B and AB. Half adder 2 takes that XOR with Cin and gives the final sum and (A XOR B)Cin. The OR gate combines AB and (A XOR B)Cin into Cout. So 2 XOR + 2 AND + 1 OR = 5 gates.
